paragraph-s2d1d1d1d2p1.text: I believe that functional training is for everyone — all ages, all genders, all backgrounds. There's no one-size-fits-all here. Whether you're just starting out or getting back on track, I'll meet you where you are and support you every step of the way.

div-s2d1d1d2.css: grid items-center gap-6 sm:gap-8 sm:grid-cols-2 sm:gap-12

paragraph-s2d1d1d2d1p1.text: Perfection isn't the goal — progress is. I focus on building sustainable habits that lead to real, lasting change. It's not about being perfect every day; it's about showing up, staying consistent, and giving yourself grace along the way.

div-s2d1d1d2d2.css: relative order-1 h-[250px] overflow-hidden rounded-xl shadow-xl sm:h-[300px] sm:order-2 sm:h-[400px]

div-s2d1d1d3.css: grid items-center gap-6 sm:gap-8 sm:grid-cols-2 sm:gap-12

div-s2d1d1d3d1.css: relative h-[250px] overflow-hidden rounded-xl shadow-xl sm:h-[300px] sm:h-[400px]

paragraph-s2d1d1d3d2p1.text: True wellness goes beyond reps and macros. My training approach connects mind, body, and soul, because real transformation starts from within. We'll work on physical strength, mental resilience, and emotional balance — together.

div-s2d1d1d4.css: grid items-center gap-6 sm:gap-8 sm:grid-cols-2 sm:gap-12

paragraph-s2d1d1d4d1p1.text: This journey is yours, but you're never alone. I'm here to guide, encourage, and empower you to become the strongest version of yourself — inside and out.
